reasons.plausibility: Restricting precursor mobility to achieve uniform noble metal dispersion and enhanced charge transfer is scientifically reasonable and aligns with established principles, though the exact extent of charge transfer remains a mild uncertainty.
reasons.testability: Comparing low-temperature and high-temperature syntheses using standardized materials characterization and catalytic tests provides a straightforward and decisive way to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly addresses controlling alloy formation pathways to optimize catalytic performance, offering a clear experimental strategy that is highly relevant to researchers in noble metal–based HEA catalysis.
